Door-to-Door refers to shipments that are collected at the sender's address and then delivered to the recipient's to await collection by the recipient. Drop-off and Hold at Location refers to shipments that are dropped off at a UPS
address. Drop-off refers to shipments that are dropped off at a UPS facility and then delivered to the recipient's facility and then delivered to another UPS facility to await collection by the recipient.
